summary: Franklin BSP Real Estate Debt, Inc. filed an 8-K on September 18, 2026, reporting that its indirect wholly-owned subsidiary FBRED REIT GSWH Seller, LLC entered a Master Repurchase Agreement with Goldman Sachs Bank USA on September 15, 2026. The facility capacity is $125,000,000, with initial maturity September 15, 2028 and a one-year extension option subject to conditions. The Company guaranteed certain Seller obligations. This is a routine financing arrangement, not a special situation; watch asset-level borrowing-base compliance and extension conditions.
